item.title: Version 0.1.16
item.description:
RunBar 0.1.16 — clean state on Strava disconnect & diagnostic logging.
• Disconnecting Strava now also wipes the 8-week sparkline history. Previously the derived weekly snapshots survived, so switching to a different Strava account (or re-connecting via your own BYO app) left the popover showing the prior account history under the new "0 runs found" line. Cleaner state, and closer to the letter of the API Agreement § 5.4 (delete Personal Data on revocation, even derived). • When Strava returns activities but none of type Run / TrailRun / VirtualRun, RunBar now logs the type histogram (e.g. "Walk×3 Workout×7") to Console.app so you can immediately see whether your activities are filtered by type or whether you authenticated against an account with no runs.
Privacy unchanged: no names, no GPS, no timestamps in logs — just type counts.
